moments.text: Split screen: two sensor views across cloud tops under a hazy sky, each with an orange crosshair; black redaction boxes at the edges.
Both views blank out for half a second, the left black then white, the right dark grey, then the clouds return.
Both views flash black and white as the sensors swing onto a taller cloud bank.
In the right view a small bright spot appears above the cloud tops, upper left of the crosshair.
The right-hand view fills the screen. The spot sits upper left of the crosshair, then drifts down to the lower right.
Contrast changes: the picture darkens around a bright central glow, and the spot moves back up to the crosshair.
The spot stays close to the crosshair, a bright point with a faint short tail below it, while clouds drift past behind.
The picture breaks up and flashes pale, then goes flat grey with no image.
A blue colour picture of open sky fades in; no spot is visible near the crosshair.
Switch to a grainy grey view of sky and dark cloud with faint scratch-like lines; the spot is not seen again.
